settings.text: One email when the new drops land. Nothing else, and you can leave any time.

settings.a: Yes. Every order placed before October 20th is guaranteed to land on your doorstep by October 30th, or we refund you in full and you keep the item.
Nothing. Shipping is free on every order in the continental US, with no minimum spend. Alaska, Hawaii and Canada are a flat $7.95.
Anything unopened can come back within 30 days for a full refund. If an item arrives damaged, send us a photo and we ship a replacement the same day - no return needed.

settings.q: Do the light-up items come with batteries?
settings.a: The rechargeable pieces - the hero masks, the under-cabinet bars and the pumpkin night light - arrive charged with a USB-C cable in the box. The battery-powered decorations take standard AA or AAA cells, which are not included.

settings.q: Do you ship outside the US?
settings.a: We ship to Canada, the UK, Ireland and Australia. Delivery runs 6-10 days, so international orders should go in before October 15th.
